text_en: Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord .
text_cn: 品行完备而遵行上主法律的， 像这样的人才算是真有福的。

text_en: Happy are those who keep his decrees, who seek him with their whole heart,
text_cn: 遵守上主诫命全心寻求他的， 像这样的人才算是真有福的。

text_en: who also do no wrong, but walk in his ways.
text_cn: 他们总不为非作恶， 只按他的道路生活。

text_en: You have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.
text_cn: 你颁发了你的命令， 叫他们严格去遵行。

text_en: O that my ways may be steadfast in keeping your statutes!
text_cn: 愿我的行径坚定， 为遵守你的章程！

text_en: Then I shall not be put to shame, having my eyes fixed on all your commandments.
text_cn: 我若重视你的每条诫律， 我就绝对不会蒙羞受辱。

text_en: I will praise you with an upright heart, when I learn your righteous ordinances.
text_cn: 我一学习你正义的判词， 就以至诚的心灵颂谢你。

text_en: I will observe your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
text_cn: 我要遵守你的规矩， 不要将我完全弃去！

text_en: How can young people keep their way pure? By guarding it according to your word.
text_cn: 青年怎样才能守身如玉？ 那就只有遵从你的言语。

text_en: With my whole heart I seek you; do not let me stray from your commandments.
text_cn: 我要用我整个的心寻觅你， 不要让我错行了你的谕旨！

text_en: I treasure your word in my heart, so that I may not sin against you.
text_cn: 我将你的话藏在我的心里， 免得我去犯罪而获罪于你。

text_en: Blessed are you, O Lord ; teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 上主，你理应受赞颂， 教训我守你的诫命。

text_en: With my lips I declare all the ordinances of your mouth.
text_cn: 你口所授的一切法度， 我要以我的唇舌叙述。

text_en: I delight in the way of your decrees as much as in all riches.
text_cn: 我喜爱你约法的道路， 就如喜爱一切的财富。

text_en: I will meditate on your precepts, and fix my eyes on your ways.
text_cn: 我要默想你的法度， 也要沉思你的道路。

text_en: I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget your word.
text_cn: 我以你的章程作喜欢， 我永不忘却你的圣言。

text_en: Deal bountifully with your servant, so that I may live and observe your word.
text_cn: 请恩待你的仆人我得以生存， 这样使我能够服从你的纶音。

text_en: Open my eyes, so that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.
text_cn: 求你开明我的眼睛， 透视你法律的奇能。

text_en: I live as an alien in the land; do not hide your commandments from me.
text_cn: 我原是寄居尘世的旅客， 不要向我隐瞒你的规则。

text_en: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
text_cn: 我因常常渴慕你的谕令， 我的灵魂便为此而成病。

text_en: You rebuke the insolent, accursed ones, who wander from your commandments;
text_cn: 你已经怒责了骄傲横蛮的人， 背弃你诫命的，是可咒诅的人。

text_en: take away from me their scorn and contempt, for I have kept your decrees.
text_cn: 请除去我所受的凌辱与轻谩， 因为我已经遵守了你的规范。

text_en: Even though princes sit plotting against me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
text_cn: 判官虽为反对我而开庭， 你仆人仍默思你的章程。

text_en: Your decrees are my delight, they are my counselors.
text_cn: 因为你的诫命是我的欢喜， 你的典章是我的谋士。

text_en: My soul clings to the dust; revive me according to your word.
text_cn: 我的灵魂虽已辗转于灰尘， 求你照你的诺言使我生存。

text_en: When I told of my ways, you answered me; teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 我陈明我的行径，你便垂听了我， 今再恳求你用你的章程教训我；

text_en: Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wondrous works.
text_cn: 请指给我你约法的路径， 我要沉思你的奇妙工程。

text_en: My soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
text_cn: 我的灵魂因忧伤而滴滴流泪， 请照你的诺言使我奋昂兴起。

text_en: Put false ways far from me; and graciously teach me your law.
text_cn: 求你不要使我走错误的道路， 求你恩赐我常遵守你的法度。

text_en: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I set your ordinances before me.
text_cn: 我选定了真理的途径， 我矢志服从你的谕令。

text_en: I cling to your decrees, O Lord ; let me not be put to shame.
text_cn: 我时常依恋着你的法度， 上主，不要叫我蒙受羞辱。

text_en: I run the way of your commandments, for you enlarge my understanding.
text_cn: 我必奔赴你诫命的路程， 因为你舒展了我的心灵。

text_en: Teach me, O Lord , the way of your statutes, and I will observe it to the end.
text_cn: 上主，给我指出你章程的道路， 我要一直到死仔仔细细遵守。

text_en: Give me understanding, that I may keep your law and observe it with my whole heart.
text_cn: 求你教训我遵守你的法律， 我要以整个心灵持守不逾。

text_en: Lead me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.
text_cn: 求你引导我走你诫命的捷径， 因为这条捷径使我非常高兴。

text_en: Turn my heart to your decrees, and not to selfish gain.
text_cn: 使我的心倾慕你的律例， 不要让我的心贪财好利。

text_en: Turn my eyes from looking at vanities; give me life in your ways.
text_cn: 求你转回我的眼目免看虚荣， 求你按着你的道路赐我生命。

text_en: Confirm to your servant your promise, which is for those who fear you.
text_cn: 求你向你的仆人实践你的预许， 即你向敬畏你的人所许的赐与。

text_en: Turn away the disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
text_cn: 求你除去我所怕的羞耻， 因为你的约法甚是甘饴。

text_en: See, I have longed for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life.
text_cn: 看，我如何渴慕你的规约， 按照你的正义，赐我生活。

text_en: Let your steadfast love come to me, O Lord , your salvation according to your promise.
text_cn: 上主，愿你的仁慈和救恩， 照你的诺言，降临于我身！

text_en: Then I shall have an answer for those who taunt me, for I trust in your word.
text_cn: 对凌辱我的人，我有所答辩， 因为我全寄望于你的圣言。

text_en: Do not take the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for my hope is in your ordinances.
text_cn: 不要由我口撤去真理的训言， 因我一心一意渴望你的判断。

text_en: I will keep your law continually, forever and ever.
text_cn: 我要常常遵守你的法典， 时时不断，一直要到永远。

text_en: I shall walk at liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
text_cn: 我要行走平坦宽阔的途径， 因为我常常追求你的诫命。

text_en: I will also speak of your decrees before kings, and shall not be put to shame;
text_cn: 我要传述你的规律， 在列王前也不畏惧。

text_en: I find my delight in your commandments, because I love them.
text_cn: 我非常喜悦你的规诫， 因为我对此有所钟爱。

text_en: I revere your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes.
text_cn: 我向你的诫命举起我的手， 对你的一切章程沉思不休。

text_en: Remember your word to your servant, in which you have made me hope.
text_cn: 求你莫把你给你仆人的诺言遗忘， 因为你在这诺言里赐给了我希望。

text_en: This is my comfort in my distress, that your promise gives me life.
text_cn: 在我的忧苦中，这是我的安慰， 因为你的圣言，赐给了我生气。

text_en: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn away from your law.
text_cn: 骄傲人虽加给我极度的侮辱， 但我却没有偏离过你的法律。

text_en: When I think of your ordinances from of old, I take comfort, O Lord .
text_cn: 我一思念到你永恒的断定， 上主，我是多么安慰而高兴。

text_en: Hot indignation seizes me because of the wicked, those who forsake your law.
text_cn: 为了背弃你法律的罪人， 我不知不觉地怒火焚心。

text_en: Your statutes have been my songs wherever I make my home.
text_cn: 在我这客居不定的寓所， 你的法令成了我的诗歌。

text_en: I remember your name in the night, O Lord , and keep your law.
text_cn: 上主，夜间我想起你的圣名， 我就决意要遵守你的法令。

text_en: This blessing has fallen to me, for I have kept your precepts.
text_cn: 我之所以如此这般， 因我守了你的法范。

text_en: The Lord is my portion; I promise to keep your words.
text_cn: 上主，我说：我的福分， 就是遵守你的教训。

text_en: I implore your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
text_cn: 我全心仰望着你的容貌， 求你按你的诺言怜悯我。

text_en: When I think of your ways, I turn my feet to your decrees;
text_cn: 我一默想到我所走的道路， 就把我的脚转向你的法度。

text_en: I hurry and do not delay to keep your commandments.
text_cn: 爽爽快快，毫不踌躇， 我常遵守你的规矩。

text_en: Though the cords of the wicked ensnare me, I do not forget your law.
text_cn: 恶人的绳索虽将我缠起， 我却未将你的法律忘记。

text_en: At midnight I rise to praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
text_cn: 为了你正义的判语， 我半夜起身赞美你。

text_en: I am a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.
text_cn: 我常向敬畏你的人为友， 与遵守你诫命的人为侣。

text_en: The earth, O Lord , is full of your steadfast love; teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 上主，你的慈爱充满大地， 求你教我遵守你的律例。

text_en: You have dealt well with your servant, O Lord , according to your word.
text_cn: 上主，你依照你的言词， 善待了你的仆役。

text_en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
text_cn: 求你以知识和聪慧教训我， 因为我一心信赖你的诫条。

text_en: Before I was humbled I went astray, but now I keep your word.
text_cn: 我在受苦以前，徘徊岐途， 但我现今顺从你的训语。

text_en: You are good and do good; teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 你是慈善的，好施仁惠， 求给我教授你的规矩。

text_en: The arrogant smear me with lies, but with my whole heart I keep your precepts.
text_cn: 骄傲人捏造谎言陷害我， 但我全心遵守你的规约。

text_en: Their hearts are fat and gross, but I delight in your law.
text_cn: 他们的心迟钝如蒙脂肪， 然而我却欢喜你的典章。

text_en: It is good for me that I was humbled, so that I might learn your statutes.
text_cn: 为叫我能学习你的法度， 受苦遭难于我确有好处。

text_en: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
text_cn: 你口中的法律对我的利益， 连千万的金银也不能相比。

text_en: Your hands have made and fashioned me; give me understanding that I may learn your commandments.
text_cn: 你的双手创造了我，形成了我， 求你赐我智力，为学你的诫条。

text_en: Those who fear you shall see me and rejoice, because I have hoped in your word.
text_cn: 敬畏你的人，见我就喜欢， 因为我常仰望你的圣言。

text_en: I know, O Lord , that your judgments are right, and that in faithfulness you have humbled me.
text_cn: 上主，我知道你的审判是公正无私的， 你叫我遭受磨难是理所当然的。

text_en: Let your steadfast love become my comfort according to your promise to your servant.
text_cn: 照你给你仆人的许诺， 按你的仁慈来安慰我。

text_en: Let your mercy come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
text_cn: 愿你的仁爱临于我，使我生活， 因为你的法律就是我的喜乐。

text_en: Let the arrogant be put to shame, because they have subverted me with guile; as for me, I will meditate on your precepts.
text_cn: 愿无端难为我的骄傲人蒙羞！ 但是我要默想沉思你的法律。

text_en: Let those who fear you turn to me, so that they may know your decrees.
text_cn: 愿那些敬畏你的人归向我， 愿关心你法律的人依附我！

text_en: May my heart be blameless in your statutes, so that I may not be put to shame.
text_cn: 愿我全心遵守你的法典， 这样我便不致自觉羞赧。

text_en: My soul languishes for your salvation; I hope in your word.
text_cn: 我灵渴慕你的救援而衰弱， 我热切地盼望着你的许诺。

text_en: My eyes fail with watching for your promise; I ask, “When will you comfort me? ”
text_cn: 我对你的诺言望眼欲穿， 究竟你何时才赐我慰安？

text_en: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I have not forgotten your statutes.
text_cn: 我虽然相似烟熏的皮囊， 我仍然不忘却你的典章。

text_en: How long must your servant endure? When will you judge those who persecute me?
text_cn: 你仆人的岁月还能有多久？ 你何时处罚迫害我的恶徒？

text_en: The arrogant have dug pitfalls for me; they flout your law.
text_cn: 不按你法律生活的骄傲人， 暗中给我挖掘了陷阱深坑。

text_en: All your commandments are enduring; I am persecuted without cause; help me!
text_cn: 你所有的一切诫命全是真道； 他们无理迫害我，求你协助我。

text_en: They have almost made an end of me on earth; but I have not forsaken your precepts.
text_cn: 他们几乎将我由地上灭绝， 但我却没有背弃你的规诫。

text_en: In your steadfast love spare my life, so that I may keep the decrees of your mouth.
text_cn: 求你按照你的仁慈使我生活， 这样我必遵守你口中的条约。

text_en: The Lord exists forever; your word is firmly fixed in heaven.
text_cn: 上主，你的圣言，存留永远， 它坚固而不移，好似苍天。

text_en: Your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands fast.
text_cn: 你所有的忠诚，代代流传， 你所造的大地，屹立不变。

text_en: By your appointment they stand today, for all things are your servants.
text_cn: 天地时常遵守你的旨意， 因为万物都是你的仆役。

text_en: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my misery.
text_cn: 我如果不喜爱你的法令， 我早已在我苦患中丧命。

text_en: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
text_cn: 我永不忘却你的法令， 因为你藉此赐我生命。

text_en: I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
text_cn: 我全属于你，求你救拔我， 因为我寻求了你的法约。

text_en: The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider your decrees.
text_cn: 恶人窥视我，想把我杀害， 然而我仍细想你的规诫。

text_en: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commandment is exceedingly broad.
text_cn: 我看任何齐全都有界限， 唯你的诫命却广阔无边。

text_en: Oh, how I love your law! It is my meditation all day long.
text_cn: 上主，我是多么爱慕你的法律， 它是我终日对你默想的题目。

text_en: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is always with me.
text_cn: 你的诫命永远存于我心， 它使我比我的敌仇聪明。

text_en: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your decrees are my meditation.
text_cn: 我比我所有的教师更聪明， 因为我常在默想你的法令。

text_en: I understand more than the aged, for I keep your precepts.
text_cn: 我比年老的人更智慧， 因为我恪守你的律例。

text_en: I hold back my feet from every evil way, in order to keep your word.
text_cn: 我使我的脚回避一切恶路， 为叫我能够遵守你的言语。

text_en: I do not turn away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
text_cn: 我不偏离你的约法， 因为是你教训了我。

text_en: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
text_cn: 你的教言对我上颚多么甘美！ 在我的口中比蜂蜜更要甘美！

text_en: Through your precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
text_cn: 由你的诫命，我获得了聪明， 因我憎恶一切欺诈的途径。

text_en: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
text_cn: 你的言语是我步履前的灵灯， 是我路途上的光明。

text_en: I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to observe your righteous ordinances.
text_cn: 我今起誓，我并决定， 坚守你正义的谕令。

text_en: I am severely afflicted; give me life, O Lord , according to your word.
text_cn: 上主，我已经受苦很重， 照你的诺言，保我生命。

text_en: Accept my offerings of praise, O Lord , and teach me your ordinances.
text_cn: 上主，请悦纳我口中的祭献， 请你教训我明白你的审断。

text_en: I hold my life in my hand continually, but I do not forget your law.
text_cn: 我的性命虽常处于危险， 但我仍不忘记你的法典。

text_en: The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from your precepts.
text_cn: 恶人虽然给我设下陷阱， 我仍然不偏离你的章程。

text_en: Your decrees are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.
text_cn: 你的诫命永做我的家产， 因为这是我心中的喜欢。

text_en: I incline my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the end.
text_cn: 我要倾心遵守你的法典， 千秋万世，一直要到永远。

text_en: I hate the double-minded, but I love your law.
text_cn: 我很恼恨心怀二意的人， 对你的法律，我喜爱万分。

text_en: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.
text_cn: 你是我的庇护我的盾牌， 因此我唯你的圣言是赖。

text_en: Go away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
text_cn: 作恶的人，你们应离我远去！ 因我要遵守我天主的法度。

text_en: Uphold me according to your promise, that I may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope.
text_cn: 照你的诺言，扶持我的生命， 不要让我的希望成为泡影。

text_en: Hold me up, that I may be safe and have regard for your statutes continually.
text_cn: 求你扶持我得蒙拯救， 能时常留意你的制度。

text_en: You spurn all who go astray from your statutes; for their cunning is in vain.
text_cn: 凡背离你法令的，你都鄙弃， 因为他们的思念全是诈欺。

text_en: All the wicked of the earth you count as dross; therefore I love your decrees.
text_cn: 地上的恶人你都看作渣滓， 因此我非常喜爱你的法制。

text_en: My flesh trembles for fear of you, and I am afraid of your judgments.
text_cn: 我的肉身因敬畏你而战栗， 对你的谕令我也知所敬畏。

text_en: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
text_cn: 我行了正义及合法的事情， 别把我交于压迫我的坏人。

text_en: Guarantee your servant’s well-being; do not let the godless oppress me.
text_cn: 求你保证你仆人的安全， 不要让骄傲人将我磨难。

text_en: My eyes fail from watching for your salvation, and for the fulfillment of your righteous promise.
text_cn: 对你的救助和你正义的诺言， 我热切渴盼得已经望眼欲穿。

text_en: Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 求你照你的仁慈恩待你的仆人， 也求你教训我能明白你的章程。

text_en: I am your servant; give me understanding, so that I may know your decrees.
text_cn: 我是你的仆人，求赐我明达， 为使我能够通晓你的约法。

text_en: It is time for the Lord to act, for your law has been broken.
text_cn: 现今是上主行动的时候， 因他们违犯了你的法度。

text_en: Truly I love your commandments more than gold, more than fine gold.
text_cn: 所以我爱慕你的诫律， 远胜各种黄金和宝玉。

text_en: Truly I direct my steps by all your precepts; I hate every false way.
text_cn: 我尊重你的一切诫命， 憎恶所有的欺诈途径。

text_en: Your decrees are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.
text_cn: 你的约法诚然是美妙神奇， 因此我的灵魂要遵守不离。

text_en: The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.
text_cn: 你的言语经过解释必会发亮光照， 连知识浅薄的人也可以通达知晓。

text_en: With open mouth I pant, because I long for your commandments.
text_cn: 我张开我的口嗟叹唏嘘， 因为我极渴慕你的诫律。

text_en: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your custom toward those who love your name.
text_cn: 求你回身向我，给我垂怜， 如素常对待爱你名者然。

text_en: Keep my steps steady according to your promise, and never let iniquity have dominion over me.
text_cn: 引导我的脚步履行你的训诰， 不要允许任何邪恶来主宰我。

text_en: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may keep your precepts.
text_cn: 求你救我摆脱人的欺压， 为使我能遵守你的律法。

text_en: Make your face shine upon your servant, and teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 求你给你的仆人显示你的慈颜， 同时也求你给我教导你的规范。

text_en: My eyes shed streams of tears because your law is not kept.
text_cn: 我的眼泪滴滴下流有如溪水， 因为他们全不遵守你的法规。

text_en: You are righteous, O Lord , and your judgments are right.
text_cn: 上主你原是公义的， 你的判决是正直的。

text_en: You have appointed your decrees in righteousness and in all faithfulness.
text_cn: 你以正义和至诚， 立定了你的诫命。

text_en: My zeal consumes me because my foes forget your words.
text_cn: 我的热火快要将我消耗殆尽， 因为我的敌人忘了你的圣训。

text_en: Your promise is well tried, and your servant loves it.
text_cn: 你的教言经过千捶百炼， 你的仆人对它爱不知倦。

text_en: I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.
text_cn: 我虽然年纪幼小，被人轻看， 可是我总不忘却你的法范。

text_en: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is the truth.
text_cn: 你的正义永远公正， 你的法律永远坚定。

text_en: Trouble and anguish have come upon me, but your commandments are my delight.
text_cn: 困苦和压迫虽然来临我身， 但你的诫命仍是我的欢欣。

text_en: Your decrees are righteous forever; give me understanding that I may live.
text_cn: 你的约法，永远公允， 赐我智慧，使我生存。

text_en: With my whole heart I cry; answer me, O Lord . I will keep your statutes.
text_cn: 我全心呼号，并求你俯听， 上主，我要遵守你的法令。

text_en: I cry to you; save me, that I may observe your decrees.
text_cn: 我呼号你，求你救护， 我必遵守你的法度。

text_en: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I put my hope in your words.
text_cn: 天还未亮，我就起来求助， 极热切地期待你的训语，

text_en: My eyes are awake before each watch of the night, that I may meditate on your promise.
text_cn: 夜里每更我都睁着眼睛， 全是为了默想你的圣训。

text_en: In your steadfast love hear my voice; O Lord , in your justice preserve my life.
text_cn: 上主，请照你的仁慈俯听我的呼声， 上主，请按你的正义使我得以重生。

text_en: Those who persecute me with evil purpose draw near; they are far from your law.
text_cn: 非法迫害我的人已临近， 他们都远离了你的法令。

text_en: Yet you are near, O Lord , and all your commandments are true.
text_cn: 上主，愿你时常与我亲近， 你一切的诫命全属忠信。

text_en: Long ago I learned from your decrees that you have established them forever.
text_cn: 我早已由你的约法得知： 那都是你从永远所定立。

text_en: Look on my misery and rescue me, for I do not forget your law.
text_cn: 求你垂视我的苦难而救拔我， 因为我总没有忘记你的法约。

text_en: Plead my cause and redeem me; give me life according to your promise.
text_cn: 求你辩护我的案件而拯救我， 并请依照你的诺言，使我生活。

text_en: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your statutes.
text_cn: 恨不得救恩远远离开恶徒， 因为他们不理睬你的法度。

text_en: Great is your mercy, O Lord ; give me life according to your justice.
text_cn: 上主，你的仁爱何其广阔， 按照你的谕旨，赐我生活。

text_en: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, yet I do not swerve from your decrees.
text_cn: 迫害与磨难我的人确实众多， 然而我却不会偏离你的法约。

text_en: I look at the faithless with disgust, because they do not keep your commands.
text_cn: 奸党恶辈我一看见就会生厌， 因为他们都不遵守你的规范。

text_en: Consider how I love your precepts; preserve my life according to your steadfast love.
text_cn: 上主，请你看我如何爱你的训令， 上主，照你的仁慈保全我的生命。

text_en: The sum of your word is truth; and every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
text_cn: 你圣言的总纲确是真实无欺， 你正义的一切判断永远不移。

text_en: Princes persecute me without cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
text_cn: 王侯虽然无缘无故加我苦难， 我的心灵仍旧敬畏你的教言。

text_en: I rejoice at your word like one who finds great spoil.
text_cn: 我对你的诺言实在欢喜若狂， 像得到许多胜利品的人一样。

text_en: I hate and abhor falsehood, but I love your law.
text_cn: 奸诈邪恶是我所恨所憎的， 你的法令是我所喜所爱的。

text_en: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous ordinances.
text_cn: 为了你那正义的判词， 我一日要赞美你七次。

text_en: Great peace have those who love your law; nothing can make them stumble.
text_cn: 爱慕你法律的必饱享平安， 没有一点失足跌倒的危险。

text_en: I hope for your salvation, O Lord , and I fulfill your commandments.
text_cn: 上主，我期待你的助佑， 上主，我遵守你的法度。

text_en: My soul keeps your decrees; I love them exceedingly.
text_cn: 我的灵魂恪守你的规诫， 因为我对规诫十分喜爱。

text_en: I keep your precepts and decrees, for all my ways are before you.
text_cn: 我必要遵守你的规诫和劝言， 因我的一切道路在你的面前。

text_en: Let my cry come before you, O Lord ; give me understanding according to your word.
text_cn: 上主，愿我的呼声上达于你， 求你照你的约言使我明理。

text_en: Let my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
text_cn: 愿我的祈求到达你的面前， 求你照你的诺言救我脱险。

text_en: My lips will pour forth praise, because you teach me your statutes.
text_cn: 愿我的双唇涌溢赞美的歌曲！ 因为你给我教授了你的法律。

text_en: My tongue will sing of your promise, for all your commandments are right.
text_cn: 愿我的舌头歌咏你的训令！ 因你的一切诫命尽属公正。

text_en: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
text_cn: 愿你伸出你的手救助我！ 因为我拣选了你的法约。

text_en: I long for your salvation, O Lord , and your law is my delight.
text_cn: 上主，我渴望你的救援， 你的法律是我的喜欢。

text_en: Let me live that I may praise you, and let your ordinances help me.
text_cn: 愿我的灵魂活着赞美你， 愿你的断语将我来支持！

text_en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.
text_cn: 我像迷路的亡羊，请寻回你的仆人， 因为我总没有忘记你的任何诫命。
